The '''Karamja Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within [[Karamja]], which include the [[Kharazi Jungle]] and [[Mor Ul Rek]]. This is the first diary to be introduced into the game. The [[Antique lamp (Karamja Diary)|antique lamps]] earned from its easy, medium, and hard tiers are different than those of other diaries.

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]] in [[Brimhaven]]'s [[Brimhaven Agility Arena|Agility Arena]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Hard==
{{Listen
|title = [[Hard Task (Karamja Diary)|Hard Task]]
|filename = Hard Task (Karamja Diary).ogg
|desc = The music that plays after completing a hard task.}}
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Karamja" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
| 1. Become the Champion of the [[TzHaar Fight Pit|Fight Pits]].
''Note: In Deadman Mode, this task is instead "Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Kah at the Fight Pits."
| 
*At least one other player
*[[Weapon]]ry, optionally
|-
| 2. Kill a [[Ket-Zek]] in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave|Fight Caves]].
''Note: [[Ket-Zek]]s start to appear on the 31st wave. You can leave the arena safely after killing it.

''This wave can be reached with relatively little effort, as long as the [[Yt-MejKot]]s are kept out of melee range and [[Protect from Missiles]] is used against the [[Tok-Xil]]s. Though, you may as well try to complete the entire [[TzHaar Fight Cave|Fight Caves]] when going for this task.
|
*See the [[TzHaar Fight Cave/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
| 3. Eat an [[oomlie wrap]].
|
*[[Cooked oomlie wrap]], or the requirements to make it ({{SCP|Cooking|50|link=yes}} {{boostable|n}}, a [[palm leaf]], and a [[raw oomlie]])
|-
| 4. Craft some [[nature rune]]s from Essence.
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|44|link=yes}}
*[[Pure essence|Pure]] or [[daeyalt essence]]
*Access to the [[Nature Altar]] ([[nature talisman]]/[[Nature tiara|tiara]], [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
| 5. Cook a [[Raw karambwan|karambwan]] thoroughly.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]] (speak to [[Tinsay]] after the quest) 
*{{SCP|Cooking|30|link=yes}}
*[[Raw karambwan]], multiple recommended in case of [[Burnt karambwan|burning]] one
|-
| 6. Kill a [[Death wing|deathwing]]{{sic}} in the [[Shaman Caves|dungeon]] under the [[Kharazi Jungle]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Legends' Quest]]
**The quest can be started without all the required skills, but reaching this area requires {{SCP|Agility|50|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Thieving|50|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Mining|52|link=yes}}, and {{SCP|Strength|50|link=yes}} (all boostable).
*Any [[axe]], any [[Machete (weapon)|machete]], any [[pickaxe]], and a [[lockpick]]
|-
| 7. Use the [[Strong_Tree_(Karamja)|crossbow shortcut]] south of the [[Karamja Volcano|volcano]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|53|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Ranged|42|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Strength|21|link=yes}}
*[[Mith grapple]]{{efn|[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] require either access to the [[Ancient Cavern]] or 59 [[Smithing]] and 59 [[Fletching]] for a [[mith grapple]].}} and any [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]
|-
| 8. Collect 5 [[Palm leaf|palm leaves]].
''Note: You can just drop and pick up the same palm leaf five times.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Legends' Quest]]
*Any [[axe]] and [[Machete (weapon)|machete]], or {{SCP|Agility|79|link=yes}} for the [[Vine (Kharazi Jungle)|vine shortcut]]
|-
| 9. Be assigned a [[Slayer]] task by the [[Duradel|Slayer Master]] in [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]].
| 
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Shilo Village]]
*{{SCP|Combat|100|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Slayer|50|link=yes}}, or a [[Slayer cape]]
|-
| 10. Kill a [[metal dragon]] in [[Brimhaven Dungeon]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|10|link=yes}}
*Any [[axe]], protection from [[dragonfire]], and [[weapon]]ry
*875 [[coins]] (unless you have unlocked permanently free access via either [[Saniboch]] or [[Banisoch]])
|}
{{Notelist}}

*[[Karamja gloves 3]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the underground portion of the [[Shilo Village mine]]
**[[Jiminua's Jungle Store]] and the [[Karamja General Store]] are now also affected by the gloves' [[Karamja gloves#Discounted shops|discounted store prices]]
*[[Antique lamp (Karamja Diary)|Antique lamp]] worth 10,000 experience in any skill of at least level 40 (instead of the usual [[Antique lamp (hard)|antique lamp]] for this tier)

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Karamja" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
| 1. Craft 56 [[Nature rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Runic extract|Extracts]].
|

|
*See the [[TzHaar Fight Cave/Strategies|strategy guide]] for the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]]
*[[Fire cape]] or [[infernal cape]]
|-
| 3. Check the health of a [[palm tree]] in [[Brimhaven]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|68|link=y}}
*[[Palm sapling]], [[spade]] and [[rake]]
*15 [[papaya fruit]] recommended to pay the [[Garth|gardener]]
|-
| 4. Create an [[Anti-venom|antivenom]] potion whilst standing in the [[Horseshoe mine|horse shoe mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Herblore|87|link=y}}{{Boostable|yes}}
*[[Antidote++]] and 5-20 [[Zulrah's scales]] (5 per dose)
|-
| 5. Check the health of your [[Calquat tree]] patch.
''Note: This is the [[farming patch]] next to [[Imiago]].
| 
*{{SCP|Farming|72|link=y}}
*[[Calquat sapling]], [[spade]] and [[rake]]
*8 [[poison ivy berries]] recommended to pay the [[Imiago|gardener]]
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Karamja gloves 4]]:
**Unlimited teleports to [[Duradel]]/[[Kuradal]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*10% chance of receiving two [[Agility arena ticket]]s and [[Brimhaven voucher]]s, instead of one, when successfully tagging a [[ticket dispenser]] at the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]]
*Free usage of Shilo Village's [[furnace]], down from a fee of 20 [[coins]] per use
*Free access to the [[Hardwood Grove]], down from a fee of 100 [[trading sticks]]
*Free [[Shilo Village cart system|cart rides]] between [[Brimhaven]] and [[Shilo Village]], down from a fee of 10-200 [[coins]]
*[[Red dragonhide]] from [[red dragon]]s in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] is now [[Bank note|noted]] (cannot be disabled)
*[[Bar]]s from [[Dragon_(race)#Metal_dragons|metal dragon]]s in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] are now [[noted]], unless this feature is disabled by talking to [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]]
*Double [[Tokkul]] from the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]], the [[Inferno]], and [[TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges]]
*Resurrect with full health and restored stats once per day when you reach 0 hitpoints in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]], allowing you to continue on with the fight (the task list of this diary will show you whether you've used this daily resurrection)

==Trivia==
*The Karamja Diary was the only Achievement Diary in ''Old School RuneScape'' until the introduction of other diaries in [[Update:Achievement Diaries|an update]] on 5 March 2015. The update also introduced an elite tier for the Karamja Diary.
*This diary's design is slightly different than other Achievement Diaries:
**The antique lamp experience for the completion of each tier is different than the other diaries.
**Completing each task, or all tasks of a tier, results in a completion audio [[jingle]]. This jingle is different for each tier, with the exception of the elite tier having no jingle at all.
**The diary had different taskmasters for each tier: [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]] for the easy tier, [[Kaleb Paramaya]] for the medium tier, the [[Jungle forester]] for the hard tier, and [[TzHaar-Mej (Diary)|TzHaar-Mej]] for the elite tier. This was changed in [[Update:Interface Improvement & More|an update]] on 30 March 2017.
